BrochureContent.Content:
Nestled on an elevated, secluded site with distant views of the Atlantic coastline, this enchanting traditional cottage perfectly blends timeless character with thoughtful modern enhancements. Beautifully extended and tastefully renovated, the property retains all the charm of its original heritage while offering the comfort and practicality of contemporary living.

Surrounded by peaceful countryside, the home enjoys an idyllic setting that feels wonderfully private, yet is just a 10-minute drive from the spectacular coastal destinations of Lahinch, Liscannor and Doolin, renowned for their beaches, dramatic cliffs, vibrant music scene and gateway to the Aran Islands.

The accommodation has been carefully designed to provide bright, welcoming living spaces and comprises a well-appointed kitchen and dining area, comfortable living room, study, shower room, utility room, three generously sized bedrooms and an attic space offering excellent potential for various uses such as reading area, etc.

Outside, the property is equally captivating. The beautifully maintained rustic gardens have been lovingly cultivated to create a peaceful haven, featuring mature hedging, established trees, colourful flower beds and seasonal planting. Wildflower areas encourage local wildlife and pollinators, while a productive vegetable garden offers the opportunity for sustainable homegrown produce. Every aspect of the grounds has been designed to complement the cottage's rural charm, creating a tranquil outdoor retreat to enjoy throughout the seasons. 

Another wonderful feature of this charming countryside cottage is its collection of versatile outbuildings, offering endless possibilities for a variety of lifestyles. The beautifully presented pottery/hobby shed provides an inspiring creative space, ideal for artists, craftspeople or those seeking a peaceful studio retreat. Complementing this is a dedicated music room, perfectly suited for enjoying your favourite hobby in a private and tranquil setting. Together, these unique spaces enhance the property's character and appeal, making it an exceptional opportunity for buyers seeking a home with creativity, flexibility and countryside charm. 

This is a rare opportunity to acquire a truly special countryside home where traditional Irish character meets modern comfort, all within easy reach of some of County Clare's most breathtaking coastal scenery.

•	Unique property in excellent condition and set on a beautiful site
•	Located 10 minutes north of Liscannor and Lahinch 
•	Traditional cottage with many original features balanced with modern conveniences
•	Three bedrooms with spacious attic area ideal for further use.
•	Amazing garden space ideal for green fingered enthusiasts' 
•	Great selection of outbuildings with multiple use potential
•	The house has been used as Airbnb for 12 years
